owned_admission.linearization: the fenced store transaction that reads approval, matching cert row, current revisioned hash, and current positive profile_activation_epoch
owned_admission.dispatch_boundary: the existing pre-dispatch check immediately before the first worker frame or generated response frame is sent
owned_admission.last_check: the dispatch path re-reads persisted profile_activation_epoch plus the approval enabled bit, semantic digest, and generation in one fenced store read, and refuses with owned_decode_not_certified when any stamped value differs or the approval is disabled

interleavings.activation_before_admission_commit: admission resolves the new epoch or fails closed
interleavings.admission_before_activation_commit: the old epoch may dispatch only if it crossed the dispatch boundary before activation committed
interleavings.resolved_before_activation_or_approval_m: re-resolve the epoch and approval stamp at the dispatch boundary or return the existing fail-closed refusal

owned_admission.fallback: only the exact six fallback-eligible refusal IDs may select a compatible llama lane for substitutable unconstrained requests

probe_snapshot.terminal_transaction: re-resolve every runtime-derived member inside the fenced cert-row write transaction
probe_snapshot.comparison: byte-exact for digests, identities, revisions, and ordered identity sets

unchanged_member.write: one immutable measured row under the complete class-specific identity

release_window.constrained: existing refusal path; no llama fallback
release_window.measurement: fleet transition report records the unavailable interval

proof_requirements: barrier-controlled activation and admission tests cover both sides of the dispatch boundary
barrier-controlled probe mutation tests change each captured tuple member and observe probe_stale
approval bytes, semantic_digest, updated_at_ms, and deployed binary digest remain unchanged during a supported rotation
